description:
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Myth Unbound until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Torsten, adding {G}. Choose to return Torsten to the command zone from your graveyard.
Torsten's second ability, Myth Unbound and Mirage Mirror trigger.
Resolve the Torsten trigger, creating seven 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Resolve the Myth Unbound and Mirage Mirror triggers, causing you to draw two cards. 
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing six Soldiers, adding {5}{W}.
Cast Torsten from the command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} and without commander tax due to Myth Unbound and Mirage Mirror.
Repeat from step 2.
